selection.policy: first eligible attempt, never classification-based retries
selection.cap: first expected_count complete parsed integers, preserve original request output limit
selection.model_identity: exact requested ID or requested ID followed by a YYYY-MM-DD or YYYYMMDD date suffix; preserve actual ID
selection.duplicates: Reject exact response-text or parsed-integer-sequence duplicates of any historical attempt or earlier v2 attempt; compare sequences only if at least 80 parsed values.
selection.retry: At most 2 physical attempts per model/challenge, including recovered interrupted traces; skip first eligible accepted slot.
selection.auth_failure: Pause new requests on HTTP 401/402/403; an explicit --resume may continue only remaining attempts without scoring.

trace.raw_bytes: Save exact response body bytes received, including failure and capped partial streams, with SHA256/byte count and safe response metadata.
trace.interrupted_resume: Recover existing unrecorded trace offline using the same parser and eligibility rules before issuing another attempt; never request a replacement for a recovered eligible trace.

deduplication.comparison_scope: Prompt/text/integer sequence only; no prediction or classification outputs are read.

aggregation.primary: 20 paired rounds, 3 replies per model per round
aggregation.optional_predeclared: 4 nonoverlapping blocks of 5 successive rounds, 15 replies per model per block; no adaptive grouping or score-based exclusions
